_doc: Stills round 4 override layer: authored in tools/pixel-pipeline/author_overrides_data.py on the render named in authored_on. Patches are pixel coordinates on that render.

face.note: yaw 41, head pitched into the thrust; the stamp sits 1 px left on the narrow face

patches.note: painted form on skin below the chin: one clean core-shadow band per limb, S4 occlusion edge, one S1 highlight (re-banded from the render normals with the key light of this still)
despeckle the render's dark I4 islands (<= 2 px) in the hair mass
crown: soften the dark seam and drop the render's straight I0 bar (the ring is redrawn as arcs)
head: the render's loose azure hairtip specks on the crown (critic: 'noise') become hair tones
angel ring: short I0 arcs with I1 ends that follow the skull outline, broken at every clump
clump separators (I3, one step darker than the I2 shadow) from the ring into the bang notches
azure tips (DESIGN s6): the last 3 px of every free hair end, A2 -> A3 -> A4
blade glint: A5 core with A4 arms (the one specular star on the weapon)
lead hand closed across the haft behind the guard, arm fully extended
rear hand at the hip, closed on the rear third of the haft where it leaves the sleeve

rim.note: skill / attack frame: the glaive glow motivates the full level (DESIGN.md s9)

authored_on._doc: The render these patches were painted on. overrides.py applies 'patches' only when the still matches (same canvas, anchor and pose file); otherwise they are stale pixel coordinates and are skipped until re-authored.

patches.note: haft highlight (I1 spec line) so the lacquered haft reads as a round shaft over the same-value sleeve lining
front (left) hand closed round the haft where it leaves the upper sleeve: fist straddles the haft at 45 deg, finger creases across it, wrist joins the rendered hand at lower left
